technique_name: Describe the atmosphere of a busy city on a Sunday afternoon.
description: The atmosphere of a busy city on a Sunday afternoon is vibrant and bustling. The sidewalks are filled with people, out to do a variety of errands – some are hurriedly checking items off their to-do lists, while others linger in cafés, spending time with friends or taking the time to sip on a warm cup of something comforting.
